summary: Brookfield Business Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting first quarter 2026 results. The release highlights operational performance, including receipt of cash tax credits at Clarios, sale of a 27% interest in La Trobe generating a 3x return, and a $500 million commitment alongside partners to invest in a new AI deployment platform with OpenAI. No specific special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is triggered by this filing; it is a routine quarterly earnings report. There are no deal terms stated. The filing is a foreign private issuer's current report equivalent to a domestic earnings release.
